_note: v2.4 plan 05 T12 live (real LLM + judge; lanes only; so-scenario run <file> --sandbox --group <group holding Arin + Ponticius>, twice). Needs the TypeSafe judge plugin configured. judge.uses.loreSelect is switched on INSTALL-WIDE for the run and put back by the last step (diff a run header around it). CASE 1 (landed): a real /trigger turn (no player message, so lore-select forces at GENERATION_STARTED); the evidence slot must list the forced pick as landed and the journal must carry no lore-force-lost. CASE 2 (T12c decision input): test/fixtures/interop/wi-foreign.js runs a foreign DRY checkWorldInfo at GENERATION_AFTER_COMMANDS, i.e. between our force and the real scan (05-H7: every checkWorldInfo, dry included, ends in resetExternalEffects). Recorded, not asserted either way: whether the pick was lost (slot.lost non-empty and a `lore` journal record lore-force-lost). If it WAS lost, T12c is owed (move the non-send force into talkControlInterceptor, after GAC, 05-H14); if not, T12c stays unbuilt. The dry scan must have run (state.dryScans >= 1, no dryErrors) or the case measured nothing. Fixed 2026-09-25 (first live run): the step-5 `send` is deliberately compact (the player's line, no generation: the /trigger turns are the measured ones); a `wait: {schedulerIdle}` before the restore lets the post-reply reads finish before sandbox cleanup deletes the chat (run 2 left the deleted chat's file re-created behind the cleanup). Fixed 2026-09-25 (second live run): a run that fails between installing the splicer/dry scan and its last step leaves those listeners on the page, and they poison every later run on the same page (a leftover splicer hid Xentar Checkpoints from the next gated-constant run and made foreign-filter read the book hidden before its own splicer); the first eval now removes any earlier run's listeners.

requires.why: real /trigger drafts of Ponticius through the T12 ring

import_story.title: SO-V2405 Lore
import_story.description: v2.4 plan 05 T12 live: lore-select forces one entry per turn from a marker book.

checkpoints.name: The Guild Hall
checkpoints.objective: Ask Ponticius about the guild's secrets.

steps.eval: if (globalThis.__soWiForeign) globalThis.__soWiForeign.off(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; if (!ctx.groupId) throw new Error('needs a group chat holding Arin and Ponticius'); const made = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-V2405 Lore' }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!made.ok && !made.message.includes('already exists')) throw new Error(`could not create the marker book: ${made.message}`); const entries = [{"comment": "Vault combination", "keys": ["zqx-vault"], "content": "The guild vault opens with the combination seven-two-nine. Only Ponticius knows it."}, {"comment": "Back room password", "keys": ["zqx-pass"], "content": "The password to the guild's back room is \"amber heron\". Ponticius changes it every winter."}, {"comment": "Trade route 1", "keys": ["zqx-route-1"], "content": "Hallow Ford trades salt for amber with Silt Harbor every spring."}, {"comment": "Trade route 2", "keys": ["zqx-route-2"], "content": "Brine Cross trades wool for rope with Greywick every summer."}]; for (const entry of entries) { const result = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-V2405 Lore', comment: entry.comment, keys: entry.keys, content: entry.content }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-V2405 Lore'] } }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`entry ${entry.comment}: ${result.message}`); } rt.refreshRequirements?.(); if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error(`requirements not ready: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().requirements)}`); return { book: 'ready', entries: entries.length };

const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; globalThis.__v2405judge = { before: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.settings.judge)) }; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, loreSelect: true } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const status = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers: SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders() }).then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null)).catch(() => null); if (!status?.configured) throw new Error(`the judge plugin is not configured here, so lore-select cannot force anything: ${JSON.stringify(status)}`); if (!globalThis.storyOrchestratorLore.selector.active()) throw new Error('lore-select is not active: the story has no lore_select scope'); return { loreSelect: true, plugin: status.pluginVersion ?? 'configured' };

steps.send: Ponticius, what do you guard in the vault under the hall? Tell me how it opens.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); globalThis.__v2405pick = { journal: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal().length }; await ctx.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/trigger await=true Ponticius', { handleParserErrors: false }); return { triggered: 'Ponticius' };

const view = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence.view(globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getStory(), globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook?.name ?? null); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const last = view().last; if (!last) throw new Error('no evidence slot for the triggered turn'); if (!last.forced.length) throw new Error(`lore-select forced nothing this turn, so the case measures nothing: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().loreForced)}`); const lostFlags = rt.getSessionJournal().slice(globalThis.__v2405pick.journal).filter((event) => event.kind === 'lore' && event.summary.startsWith('lore-force-lost')); if (last.lost.length || lostFlags.length) throw new Error(`DEFECT: a forced pick did not reach the reply with no foreign scan in between: ${JSON.stringify({ lost: last.lost, flags: lostFlags.map((event) => event.summary) })}`); return { forced: last.forced.map((pick) => pick.comment), landed: last.landed.map((pick) => pick.comment), fired: last.fired.map((row) => `${row.comment}:${row.origin}`) };

globalThis.__soWiForeign.dryScanAfterCommands(); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); globalThis.__v2405pick.journal = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal().length; await ctx.executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/trigger await=true Ponticius', { handleParserErrors: false }); return { triggered: 'Ponticius', foreignDryScan: 'armed' };

const view = () => globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence.view(globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getStory(), globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook?.name ?? null); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = globalThis.__soWiForeign.state; if (state.dryScans < 1 || state.dryErrors.length) throw new Error(`the foreign dry scan did not run cleanly, so T12c measured nothing: ${JSON.stringify(state)}`); const last = view().last; if (!last?.forced.length) throw new Error('lore-select forced nothing on the dry-scan turn, so T12c measured nothing'); const lostFlags = rt.getSessionJournal().slice(globalThis.__v2405pick.journal).filter((event) => event.kind === 'lore' && event.summary.startsWith('lore-force-lost')); if (Boolean(last.lost.length) !== Boolean(lostFlags.length)) throw new Error(`DEFECT: the slot and the journal disagree about the lost pick: ${JSON.stringify({ lost: last.lost, flags: lostFlags.length })}`); return { T12c: last.lost.length ? 'PICK LOST to a foreign dry scan: T12c is owed' : 'pick survived the foreign dry scan: T12c not built', forced: last.forced.map((pick) => pick.comment), lost: last.lost.map((pick) => pick.comment), dryScans: state.dryScans };

'restored' : root.settings.judge.uses.loreSelect };
